about: SCC-U outcome wording for the Income Tax login (autofill-tweaks blueprint G.2 step 4). Every rule must carry examples and counter_examples; a rule that fails them, or whose example another rule of a different outcome claims first, is refused at load and the previous version of that rule keeps running. A rule matches a page when its 'urls' (regexes on the page address, if any) AND its 'patterns' (regexes on any one line, if any) both hold. Wording that no tools/vsdc_uia_probe_output/*.txt dump has shown yet carries "unconfirmed": true - it is a best reading, to be replaced by real wording from tools/vsdc_uia_probe.py, never widened by guessing. Precedence when a page matches several: locked, wrong_password, worked, neutral, no_conclusion.

messages.wrong_password: The portal did not accept that password (marked ✗). The highlighted row is next.
messages.locked: The portal says this account is locked. Stop here: do not try any more passwords.
messages.ask_which: Logged in. Which password did you use? Press "This one worked" on it, or "None - I typed my own".

rules.name: itr_logged_in_header
rules.note: The profile menu button in the portal header, on every logged-in page: '<NAME> Individual' (the itr_header_name spec in core/sgt/sgt_fields.json). A CA/ERI login shows a role instead, which does not count. Group 1 is the name, for the 'must agree with the client' check.

rules.name: itr_wrong_password
rules.note: The message on the password page after a wrong password. Unconfirmed: ask staff to run tools/vsdc_uia_probe.py on ONE real wrong-password attempt (never repeat it to a lock-out).
examples: Invalid Password. You have 4 attempts left.

rules.name: itr_locked
rules.note: The lock-out message. Unconfirmed, and it must never be produced on purpose on a real account: the wording will come from a taxpayer who was locked out by accident, if ever.
examples: Your account has been locked due to multiple invalid attempts.
You have exceeded the maximum number of login attempts
counter_examples: Invalid Password. You have 4 attempts left.
Invalid Password. Your account will be locked after 3 more attempts.
Unlock your account by Forgot Password

rules.name: itr_otp_or_secure_access
rules.note: Steps between the password and the dashboard that say nothing about the password: an OTP page, the secure access message page. The attempt goes on waiting.
examples: OTP has been sent to your registered mobile

rules.name: itr_everify_steps
rules.note: A portal address inside an e-verification flow. Address only: the menu item 'e-Verify' is in the header of every logged-in page, so the words alone prove nothing.

rules.name: itr_forgot_or_reset_page
rules.note: The forgot / reset password pages, by address only: the password page itself carries a 'Forgot Password?' link, so those words alone prove nothing.

rules.name: itr_reset_heading
rules.note: A page whose heading is exactly this; the password page's link has a '?' after it.

rules.name: gst_wrong_password
rules.note: The GST portal error after a wrong username or password attempt. Unconfirmed: verify against a real wrong-password UIA probe dump.

rules.name: gst_logged_in
rules.note: GST portal dashboard elements visible only when logged in. Unconfirmed: verify with a real logged-in UIA probe.

rules.name: gst_locked
rules.note: GST portal lockout message. Unconfirmed: must never be reproduced intentionally.

rules.name: traces_wrong_password
rules.note: TRACES portal error after a wrong username or password attempt. Unconfirmed: verify against a real wrong-password UIA probe dump.
examples: User ID or Password is incorrect

rules.name: traces_logged_in
rules.note: TRACES dashboard elements visible only when logged in. Unconfirmed: verify with a real logged-in UIA probe.

rules.name: traces_locked
rules.note: TRACES portal lockout message. Unconfirmed: must never be reproduced intentionally on a real account.
